attestations.title: Formulas that return people
attestations.text: Some formulas return people's names and business contact details. By accepting, you confirm for this account that: you have a lawful basis for contacting the people these formulas return; you will use the rows for business contact only; you will honour every request to opt out, and add it to the account's suppression list; and you will follow the email and telephone marketing rules of each recipient's country. You can read what each formula returns on its page before you run it.
